n_timed_note: E0 produces no latency result; the toy kernel is a tool check. The only timed samples here are the 100 compiled-MLP calls inside stack_verification.json, which are a sanity figure, not a protocol measurement.
power_mode_deviation: PROTOCOL DEVIATION: protocol §1 requires MAXN (id 0). This run is at MODE_30W (id 2), the board default, because switching to MAXN requires a reboot on this board and AGENTS.md forbids confirming a reboot prompt. In MODE_30W 4 of 8 GPU TPCs are power-gated (8 of 16 SMs) and the GPU is capped at 612 MHz. No number from this run characterises the Orin.
jetson_clocks: applied after the idle power log and after the toy profiler runs; raw/jetson_clocks_show_locked_30W.txt is the locked state. power_idle.csv and both toy profiler runs were taken with clocks UNLOCKED (schedutil).
bench_commit_note: HEAD when bench/collect_platform.py ran. It may predate the commit that first contains bench/, and the tree may have been dirty, so it does not by itself identify the code that ran: bench_files_sha256 does. The committed harness for this run is the one whose hashes are listed there.

notes: ncu on this device needs root: perf_event_paranoid=1 alone still gives 'Insufficient privileges to launch app for profiling'. Substitution recorded per protocol §3: every ncu run is 'sudo $(which ncu) ...'.

All dram__* counters read 0 in the ncu export; ncu's 'Memory Throughput' on this Orin is the L2 (lts__) throughput, not DRAM. Off-chip traffic must come from lts__t_sectors_aperture_sysmem_*.sum x 32 B (validated to 0.4 % on the toy kernel). See env/README.md §6 and ncu/metric_presence.csv.
Warp-stall reasons are absent from the ncu 'details' page and present on the 'raw' page as smsp__average_warps_issue_stalled_*_per_issue_active.ratio.
tegrastats on this carrier board does not print VDDQ_VDD2_1V8AO; it must be read from /sys/bus/i2c/drivers/ina3221/1-0041/hwmon/hwmon4/in2_*.
nsys --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi kills the target at cudaProfilerStop (exit 143) unless --capture-range-end=stop is passed.
Passwordless sudo was not configured on this device (AGENTS.md prerequisite); the human supplied the password for this session only.
